DashboardFeaturedStay.title: Plan Your Stay
DashboardFeaturedStay.description: Hand-picked list shown in the “Plan your stay with us” carousel on the influencer home page. Curated separately from <link>Featured Campaigns</link>. Lower position = appears first.

DashboardFeaturedStay.emptyFallback: Until you publish at least one, the influencer home falls back to a built-in placeholder list.
